'''Sha''' was a title used by [[Cabrool Nuum]], the head of a powerful criminal organization. During a visit to Cabrool Nuum, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] always used the honorific when using only his hosts first name (i.e., "Sha Cabrool")
